The '''Talcim Cluster''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that had a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility that was abandoned and forgotten.

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] there used the [[Iron Mine|asteroid mining facility]] as a staging point to bring 16 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] which were stolen from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] arsenal. These were made into a group called [[Noshow]]. Their plan was to use the escort shuttles to attack planets in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam Sector]] that were sympathetic to the rebels with biological weapons to frame the rebels for attacking their planets. The Rebels however, had sent a strike team consisting of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] on what they thought would be a hit and run tactic only to soon learn the plan and attempt to stop it. The Imperials upon learning of the rebel attack force sent [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and called for [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger squadron]] in [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]].

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome of the battle depends on which side the player takes.
